item.description:
Thimble 0.5.1 tidies the Dashboard and brings Claude's limits back to life.
- Every card on the Dashboard is the same size, with Claude's line at the bottom so it lines up across a row. - A project's card and where it stands sit in their own panel at the top of the project, with more room around them. - Claude's 5-hour and weekly limits update again. The status line command couldn't save them when run through `~/.local/bin/thimble`, so the Dashboard showed limits from hours before. - A Refresh button after the week's summary reads Claude's limits and logs again right away.
